name: Isracard
description: Israeli credit-card issuer and payments company (est. 1975 by Bank Hapoalim), issuing Isracard, Mastercard, Amex and co-branded cards such as El Al's Fly Card.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

notes: Apr 2024: NIS 25M budget moved from Publicis to Reuveni-Pridan after 12 years. The Aug 2026 Fly Card (El Al + Isracard) ad was made by McCann Tel Aviv (Globes). Agency as of 2026-06: Reuveni-Pridan lists Isracard among its main clients (Globes, Jun 2026). Marketing VP Amit Sagi left in 2025; successor not confirmed in trade press. Feb 2026: Adar Goren (Isracard marketing & data manager for four years, acting marketing VP) promoted to VP Data, Digital & Marketing under new CEO Itamar Forman (Globes).
